108: One who kneads - [that is,] once the water has been added and [the dough] rolled, it is liable for ḥalla, [even though] it still needs much kneading, smoothing and pounding.
One who smooths - spreads it out and coats it.
Let it be derived due to tithes - hasn’t its work already been completed for tithes? [A worker] should also not be allowed to eat during the grinding and sifting that comes before kneading.
